title: 第1973章 不要脸的女人第1972章 你还给我
lines: 她不相信，她也不愿意相信，这绝对不可能。
瞧着她一脸狰狞的样子，周围的所有人看着周晓蜜，眼眸之中都露出了不屑。
就这样的女人，会成为顾家的少奶奶？
这压根就是不可能的事情。
只是让他们惊诧的是，君雅思居然是君耀集团的人。
心里想着顾少卿是何人，如果是一般的家庭，顾家会同意吗？门不当户不对，绝对会反对他们在一起的。
而如今顾家非但没有反对，连同花家也都是同意的。
这样一来就足以证明了她的身份不简单。
君耀集团与顾氏集团攀上亲戚关系，这以后在海城就等同于如虎添翼了。
“君雅思，你给不要脸的女人，你还敢冒充君耀集团的人？”
对于周晓蜜的话，君雅思是一点都不生气，反倒是觉得她有点可怜。她一直都想要与自己作对，可是却连自己的真实身份都不知道。
也不知道她哪里来的勇气，跟她作对。
到这一刻，君雅思觉得自己跟她计较确实是很浪费时间跟精力，因为这人压根就不值得。
还不如按照顾少卿的想法，将她送给警察算了。
“我是不是君耀集团的人，你很快就知道了。但是从这一刻起，你周晓蜜，我要以君耀集团继承人君雅思的身份告你，对我本人所有做过的一切，我们法庭上见。”
单单一条雇凶伤人这一点，就足够她喝一壶了。
只要沾染上了官司，被判了刑法，那么她这一辈子就有一个永远也抹不去的污点。
这对于一个豪门贵女来说，无疑是一个致命点，就算你不发展自己的事业，那么就算你想要找一个好一点的婆家，也会受到很大的影响。
君耀集团四个字就像是一记重锤一般，狠狠地砸在了周晓蜜的心头。
她没有想到，她真的会是君耀集团的人，而且还是君耀集团的继承人。
豪门里的等级分别也是很严重的，继承人一般都是家里的男人继承，就算是女人继承，那也得有非凡的实力。
所以，女人继承的少之又少。
在很多时候，女人对于豪门来说不过只是一个附庸品，根本就没有多少地位。
但继承人却不一样，这个地位跟她们这些什么都没有的女人来说，完全是不一样的。
周围所有的人都很惊诧，完全没有想到她竟然是君耀集团的继承人。
周志豪更是一张脸惨白成了一片，顾家就已经是他难以攀附的存在了，却没有想到在来一个君家。
周晓蜜整个人更是愣在了原地，脑子里只剩下嗡嗡一片。
“不，你不是君耀集团的继承人。”她不相信，也不愿意相信。
一直以来她都以为她只是一个穷学生，就算是有点钱，那也是顾少卿照顾她的。
并不是她自己的，顾少卿喜欢也只是看着她长得漂亮而已。
不，顾少卿根本就不喜欢她，否则的话为什么在那晚上的事情发生之后，顾少卿没有为她出头？
一定是这样的，一定是！！
content_en:
She didn't believe it, and she didn't want to believe it. This was absolutely impossible.
Seeing her ferocious look, everyone around looked at Zhou Xiaomi with disdain in their eyes.
Will a woman like this become the young mistress of the Gu family?
This is simply impossible.
What surprised them was that Jun Yasi was actually from Junyao Group.
I was thinking about who Gu Shaoqing was. If it was an ordinary family, would the Gu family agree? If they are not the right family, they will definitely oppose their being together.
But now, not only did the Gu family have no objection, but the Hua family also agreed.
This is enough to prove that her identity is not simple.
The Junyao Group has a close relationship with the Gu Group, which will be like adding more power to a tiger in Haicheng.
"Jun Yasi, you are a shameless woman, how dare you pretend to be from Junyao Group?"
Jun Yasi was not angry at all about Zhou Xiaomi's words, but felt a little pitiful for her. She has always wanted to go against herself, but she didn't even know her true identity.
I don’t know where she got the courage to go against her.
At this moment, Jun Yasi felt that it was really a waste of time and energy to argue with her, because this person was not worth it at all.
It's better to take care of Shaoqing and send her to the police.
"You will know soon whether I am from the Junyao Group. But from this moment on, you, Zhou Xiaomi, I will sue you as Jun Yasi, the heir of the Junyao Group. We will see you in court for everything I have done."
Just hiring a murderer to hurt someone is enough for her to drink a pot.
As long as she gets involved in a lawsuit and is sentenced to criminal law, there will be a stain in her life that can never be erased.
This is undoubtedly a fatal point for a rich and noble girl. Even if you don't develop your own career, even if you want to find a better husband's family, it will be greatly affected.
The four words "Junyao Group" were like a heavy hammer, hitting Zhou Xiaomi's heart hard.
She did not expect that she would really be a member of Junyao Group, and she would also be the heir of Junyao Group.
The hierarchy in wealthy families is also very serious. Heirs are usually inherited by men in the family. Even if a woman succeeds, she must have extraordinary strength.
Therefore, women inherit very little.
In many cases, women are just accessories to wealthy families and do not have much status at all.
But the heir is different. This status is completely different from that of women like them who have nothing.
Everyone around was surprised and had no idea that she was the heir to the Junyao Group.
Zhou Zhihao's face turned pale. The Gu family was already an existence that was difficult for him to grasp, but he didn't expect that a Jun family would come.
Zhou Xiaomi was stunned on the spot, and there was only a buzz in her head.
"No, you are not the heir to Junyao Group." She didn't believe it, and she didn't want to believe it.
She had always thought that she was just a poor student. Even if she had some money, it was Gu Shaoqing who took care of her.
It's not her own. Gu Shaoqing only likes her because she looks beautiful.
No, Gu Shaoqing didn't like her at all. Otherwise, why didn't Gu Shaoqing stand up for her after what happened that night?
It must be like this, it must be! !
title_en: Chapter 1973 Shameless Woman Chapter 1972 Give it back to me
